verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents a public REST API in depth. It covers OAuth2 client-credential access with scoped, expiring keys, synchronous, asynchronous and batch screening, and polling of onboarding status. Cases, alerts and risks can be remediated through the API, and the docs also cover webhook endpoints, rate-limit headers, endpoint versioning, a Postman collection, a downloadable OpenAPI schema and an llms.txt index. The probe's 404s on guessed OpenAPI paths do not contradict the documented schema download. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use, and a directly retrievable OpenAPI spec at a stable public URL.
